analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,443,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,692,200 KRW)/SMA20 (1,772,100 KRW)/SMA50 (1,670,870 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position vs SMA100 (1,933,168 KRW)/SMA200 (1,439,372 KRW): long-term trend weak, near SMA200.
· 52-week position (40.2%) + current price level approaching historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (55.1→31.9): entered oversold territory, suggesting potential rebound.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1951.3→-31679.4): bearishness continues, strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band 1,579,686 KRW): approaching lower band, possibility of further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,373,000 KRW): 4.85% downside potential from 52-week low.
· Swing resistance (1,890,000 KRW): requires a 31.0% rise from current price.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low 1,425,000 KRW, 20-day low 1,425,000 KRW, 5-day high 1,855,000 KRW, 20-day high 1,935,000 KRW. No clear pattern.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.25x): increased volume on recent sharp decline, confirming selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, awaiting rebound after entering oversold. However, trend reversal is uncertain due to continued non-trending ADX.
